motivation_ko: 원본에도 존재하는 ridge의 미실현을 exact writer로 제거하기보다, native writer 아래에서 실행될 요청 잔차를 모든 층에서 함께 계획한다. v12의 virtual delta 예산 밖으로 생기던 상속 보정 RHS를 제거한다.

scope.v13_running_B1: UNCHANGED; frozen V13 documents, execution command, source and jobs not modified

claim_ko: native writer의 실제 응답을 고려한 공동 local 요청 생성과 요청 예산 배분. 최소 semantic damage/최소 writer energy/정확 실현을 보장한다는 주장은 하지 않는다.

batch_entry.model_benchmark_logical_B: runtime profile; algorithm supports adapter-provided sizes, layers and actual context counts

variables.u: u_lr in R^{d_l}; initialized zero at all eligible sites
variables.requested_residual: R_lr=a_lr*u_lr; R is the actual ridge right-hand-side target, not a realized hidden change
variables.budget: for every request r: sum_l ||u_lr||_2 <= c
variables.meaning_ko: 요청량 규제다. 실제 주입량 v의 norm을 쓰는 native compute_z와 완전히 동일하다고 부르지 않는다. v12의 요청량 비용과 공유 예산을 유지한다.

candidate_builder.restart: Each candidate starts from identical W_entry/H_entry; no accumulation of previous candidate writes or history.
candidate_builder.loop: Traverse every eligible site in model causal order, including zero requested columns and layers.
candidate_builder.actual_keys: All native rows propagate through candidate lower all-token writes. Capture current actual subject keys k_actual_lrc; aggregate native nested rewrite-only means K_l with one column per original occurrence.
candidate_builder.native_matrix_semantics: Use native stored A/order/dtype, no symmetrization/jitter/exact writer/nullspace replacement. The ideal energy theorem separately assumes symmetric positive definite A.
candidate_builder.local_target: z_local_lr=h_actual_pre_lr+R_lr, conceptually. Pass stored R directly as solve RHS; do not reconstruct R by subtracting rounded h from z and do not use v12 frozen virtual z.
candidate_builder.no_unbudgeted_tracking: No additive (h_virtual_pre-h_actual_pre) correction and no remaining-layer divisor or L8 completion.
candidate_builder.deployment_forward: Current profile W_eff_l=W_entry_l+FP32(R_l64 P_l^T); linear operation performed once with that materialized weight.
candidate_builder.actual_subject_action: v_actual_lrc=F.linear(k_actual_lrc,W_eff_l)-F.linear(k_actual_lrc,W_entry_l), bias cancels; canonical FP32 reference. Also record ideal U*k and effective-weight action separately.
candidate_builder.causal_continuation: Continue actual all-token builder with W_eff to next eligible site; upper keys/P depend on lower R.
candidate_builder.zero_requested_column: Retain zero-target columns. Cross-talk can still make their realized action nonzero.
candidate_builder.zero_whole_layer: U=0 forward value at R=0 is allowed, but do not remove its optimization/Jacobian path; dU/dR is generally nonzero at R=0.

fit.intervention: Native subject positions only. Inject v_actual_lrc from builder into a second subject-only native forward for the same row/owner/site.
native_preserved: NLL target/token/context reduction and readout layer
KL current||entry over full vocabulary and native KL readout
fit.native_changed_ko: 주입 위치는 같지만 주입 벡터는 context별 writer 작용이다. 이것은 v10 T-prime 형태를 재사용하며 native/v12의 context 공통 R 직접 주입과 다르다.
fit.objective: J_sum(u)=sum_r [NLL_native_r(v_actual(u))+lambda_K KL_native_r(current(u)||entry)+beta_r sum_l ||u_lr||]; report J_sum/B and per-request components.
fit.gradient: Full coupled gradient of sum over ALL requests. Differentiate through actual causal keys, native means, P solve, U, actual subject actions and masked subject forward. W_entry,H_entry,anchors,entry teacher fixed.
fit.norm_gradient: One analytic beta_r*u_lr/||u_lr|| term per block, zero subgradient at origin; never also include a duplicated autograd norm penalty.
fit.no_detach: No teacher-style detach of v, upper keys or P. Frozen-geometry gradients may be measured as negative controls, never presented as the same method.
fit.residual_gap: Subject-only prestate differs from all-token actual prestate. Matching local v does NOT imply fit NLL equals committed NLL or full trajectory equality.

optimizer.method: v12 EfficiencyAdam with its existing moments/gamma/epsilon coordinate convention and shared Euclidean group-norm projection.
optimizer.unit: Per-request moment/counter and constraint retained; gradients contain all request losses, so requests no longer optimize independently.
optimizer.scaling: Differentiate summed request objectives; if backend reduces a mean, multiply its VJP by actual B consistently before optimizer. This prevents an accidental 1/B step change, not scientific invariance to batch composition.
optimizer.synchronous: All request blocks update on common candidate index; no permanent request-wise early freeze.
optimizer.early_exit: At a common candidate, stop only if every current per-request Jr is below native profile threshold .05; otherwise continue to the shared evaluation cap.
optimizer.terminal: last fully evaluated finite common candidate, not best evaluation-set candidate
optimizer.budget_after_storage: Retain v12 FP64 projection/FP32 castback feasibility contract; no hidden extra clipping or new warm-up.
optimizer.zero_reentry: All layers' gradient/moment paths retained; zero-allocation sites can reenter.

commit.weights: Commit the exact materialized weight payload of the accepted candidate's causal native builder; no new target policy or stale-key rebuild.
commit.key_refresh: Last candidate builder already recomputes each upper key after its own lower actual writes; commit replays that same sequence.
commit.history: After all writes, native rewrite-only final mean keys append once per original occurrence at every eligible layer; no KL/context Gram replacement, success filtering or deduplication.
commit.history_cache: Accepted builder mean keys can replace extra final recapture only after adapter proof and actual-model parity that later writes cannot affect earlier input keys.
commit.transaction: W/H/RNG/cache rollback on technical failure; observer evaluation cannot mutate endpoint. No persistent model checkpoint introduced.

mathematical_guarantees.assumptions: Exact arithmetic symmetric SPD A and native mean-key ridge; numerical FP32 realization/actual stored asymmetric A verified separately.
mathematical_guarantees.total_energy_bound: sum_l Q_l <= (c^2/4) sum_r max_l a_lr^2, for the actual candidate-dependent keys as well.
mathematical_guarantees.interpretation_ko: 계획한 R 예산이 이상적 writer 보존 에너지의 상한과 연결된다. v12는 writer R=D+상속항이므로 D 예산만으로 이 상한을 주장할 수 없었다.
not_guaranteed: history growth implies a particular layer share falls
mathematical_guarantees.compensation: Optimizer may increase R within its fixed budget to offset shrinkage. No explicit inverse-realization factor is used; unlimited or plan-external compensation is excluded, not all compensation.

differences.v12: virtual D direct injection -> writer-realized native subject actions; frozen virtual absolute z -> actual-state requested residual R; independent fitting -> coupled fitting; tracking RHS -> direct requested RHS. Writer ridge/history unchanged.
differences.v10: T-prime execution idea reused, but v10's unbounded q/raw coefficients and realized-norm regularization replaced by v12 requested-R penalty + hard shared budget; no G-only allocation/pulse/reference objective.
differences.v13: no equality/context-exact writer. Native mean ridge and its soft preservation tradeoff retained; change resides in planner and target/execution contract.

open_scientific_risks: native masked fit versus all-token deployed base gap remains
cross-request and context effects can damage locality despite energy bound
nonconvex coupled optimization may redistribute by optimizer history within 24 updates
requested budget may constrain accuracy; no automatic coefficient/radius change
compute exceeds writer-free v12 fit unless measured optimization offsets it
